Career Opportunities

Position Number G82: I Know First is looking for a talented junior financial analyst for the business and marketing team
We are looking for a talented analyst, with a passion for the capital market and the fintech industry. Someone self-motivated, as well as willing to find ways to consistently improve and innovate.
If you are willing to grow in the stock market/fintech world and consider yourself an out-of-the-box thinker, self-driven and eager to succeed, I Know First is the place for you.
The analyst will be part of the business and marketing team and will be involved with the company’s major projects.
The junior financial analyst will be part the daily operations flow, including financial analysis, content management, marketing and branding activities, social media management and business development tasks.
Job requirements:
  • Academic degree in Business Administration / Economics/ Industrial Management Engineering from a recognized academic institution/
  • Knowledge and passion for the capital market
  • Business orientation / Marketing
  • Willing to assume managerial role (no previous experience required)
  • Fluent in Office, Excel
  • Fluent English (writing and conversation)
  • Assertiveness
  • Ability to manage and lead the company’s projects

Office location: Tel Aviv Port

Please send your CV by email: jobs@iknowfirst.com for jobs G82
Position Number G83: I Know First is looking for an operations manager/ team leader

If you consider yourself an out-of-the-box thinker, self-driven and eager to succeed, I Know First is the place for you. The team manager will work closely with the CEO and will be involved with the company’s major projects.
The team leader will manage the daily operations flow, including financial analysis, content management, marketing and branding activities, social media management, recruiting and business development tasks.

Position Number G85: Research Analyst
 

Immerse yourself in the world of analyzing financial markets, algorithmic performance, conducting market research and business development strategies.

After learning how to analyze and implement the algorithm, you will be expected to do in-depth research and analysis for articles that will be posted on financial publication websites for our analytical branch, I Know First Research. The intern will be working hands on with I Know First staff in terms of business development and is expected to be able to take initiative.

Responsibilities include:

  • Analyzing algorithmic performance
  • Performing qualitative and quantitative research of financial markets and writing exemplary articles representing I Know First research
  • Collaborating with the I Know First team to develop and enhance general business strategies
  • Assisting in day to day operations, as needed

Requirements:

  • Academic degree in Business Administration / Economics/ Industrial Management Engineering from a recognized university
  • English or Hebrew as a mother tongue, must be able to speak English
  • Advanced web search and research skills across industries and markets
  • Proficient with Microsoft Office, especially Excel
  • Well-organized and passionate about the product and vision
Office location: Tel Aviv Port
Please send your CV by email jobs@iknowfirst.com for jobs G85
